chart.title: Global aviation fatalities per million passengers
chart.subtitle: Commercial airliners (passenger-only and cargo) with a capacity for more than 14 passengers. Fatalities from hijackings also included in airliner accidents.
chart.citation: Aviation Safety Network (2024); International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), via World Bank (2026)

descriptionKey: Fatal accidents, hijacking incidents and numbers of fatalities are based on airliners of 14+ passengers, and do not include corporate jet and military transport accidents.
Information contained in the Aviation Safety Network database is based on information from official sources, such as authorities and safety boards.
Fatalities per million passengers.descriptionProcessing: - Calculated by dividing the number of fatalities, from the Aviation Safety Network, by the number of worldwide passengers, from the World Bank's World Development Indicators, and multiplying by 1,000,000.
